scripts.dev: pnpm db:up && pnpm db:deploy && pnpm db:generate && dotenv -e .env -- concurrently --names web,api,source --prefix-colors magenta,cyan,yellow "pnpm --filter @mini-otl/web dev" "pnpm --filter @mini-otl/api dev" "pnpm --filter @mini-otl/source dev"
scripts.db:deploy: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @mini-otl/api exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:migrate: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @mini-otl/api exec prisma migrate dev
